# ghost/unitto

Convert physical lengths in Unitto, read the displayed result, choose units, swap them, enter a value or clear it. Offline; no currency or personal tools.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/unitto
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/unitto open_converter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/unitto set_units --device <serial> --param from_unit=<from_unit> --param to_unit=<to_unit>
ghost skill run ghost/unitto set_value --device <serial> --param value=<value>
ghost skill run ghost/unitto read_state --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/unitto swap_units --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/unitto clear_value --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/unitto convert_length --device <serial> --param from_unit=<from_unit> --param to_unit=<to_unit> --param value=<value>
```

## Actions

- `open_converter`: Open the offline Unitto length converter
- `set_units`: Select the source and target length units
- `set_value`: Enter a nonnegative decimal and read the displayed result
- `read_state`: Read current units and input/output displays
- `swap_units`: Swap the current source and target length units
- `clear_value`: Clear both converter values to zero
- `convert_length`: Open, set both length units and convert a value
